original_test_intent: Read and decode the complete approved SOL configuration baseline for one BMC channel—including enable, authentication, retry, bit rates, payload channel and port—without activating or changing SOL.
original_method: Query Transport 0x0C/0x22 for the listed selectors with set/block 0x00/0x00 and inspect response data; source includes bit-rate encoding and internal Script.
manual_activity: Security/FAE owner supplies the approved channel/selectors, expected baseline, dependent-field interpretation and redaction policy once.
safety_requirements: Do not put password in argv/evidence
Do not call setter or activate SOL
Do not clear active Set In Progress
engineer_actions: Interpret active ownership or unsupported selector

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek's sol info command is only partial and unsafe in credential handling; it does not execute the explicit selector-level procedure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected credential injection for the preserved bounded 0x0C/0x22 selector queries, parse dependencies and use sol info only as an independent cross-check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw command, eight selectors, bit-rate values, set/block bytes, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run selector-specific protected reads with strict parsing/dependency validation, compare to baseline and sol info, and retain a no-mutation boundary.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic criteria, safe credentials and redaction while retaining every source selector.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: sol info alone may omit selector/set/block or dependent-field semantics; raw completion without decoding likewise does not validate configuration correctness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SOL settings reveal console/authentication endpoints, and misreading volatile/nonvolatile bit rates or payload port relationships can create a false security baseline.

project_override_considerations: A vendor inventory API is equivalent only if engineer-approved and it returns every requested SOL parameter with ownership/dependency/freshness evidence; original 0x22 raw coverage remains explicit if skipped.
expected_evidence: Verified target/channel/selector scope and Project baseline
Redacted per-selector requests and complete responses
Decoded enable/auth/retry/bit-rate/payload-channel/port and Set In Progress ownership

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The selector procedure is internally consistent; the no-error Criteria is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and selectors are explicit. Channel, parser, baseline and redaction are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores the exact selector-level coverage, removes unsafe credential handling and replaces unstructured output with dependency-aware parsing while forbidding automatic SOL mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: SOL configuration contains dependent and paired fields: volatile rate may follow nonvolatile policy, and payload channel/port must be interpreted together. A generic sol info rendering can normalize or omit these relationships, so the raw selector responses must be decoded first and compared to both the Project baseline and the independent high-level view.
